rationale: The stock gapped up ~19.5% on an earnings beat but is now sitting at 34% of today's range, below VWAP ($12.29) and showing a sharp drop in the most recent candle (from $12.24 to $12.16 on elevated volume of 6121), suggesting distribution pressure after the gap.
